Assumptions // Data sources

Traced from the drawings, scaled with the 130'-0" overall dimension. Directions are plan-relative (FRONT = street side per site plan). EST = estimate.

Read from drawings

  • Overall 130'-0" wide (sheet 1); depth ≈78'-10" (site plan).
  • Upstairs 26'-0" × 30'-6" (sheet 2), over front garage / stairs / utility.
  • Main ceiling 10'-1"; 1'-5" floor system; upstairs ceiling 9'-1" → upstairs floor 11'-6", plate 20'-7" (elevation note).
  • Roof planes, ridges, valleys & eaves from roof plan (sheet 7), which overlays the floor plan within ~0.5 ft. Eave overhang 1'-9" (roof plan note).
  • Pitches: 3:12 sheds (left wing, safe room, terrace, study/entry, bedroom 2, bath 2, rear-right garage); 5:12 gables (master bedroom, family/dining/kitchen, game room, upstairs rear block, front garage); 4:12 (upstairs front); porch flat ¼"/ft.
  • Plate heights used: 14'-10" (left wing high wall), 7'-11" (safe room), 11'-1", 13'-4" (front of family), 15'-8" (entry), 9'-7" (bedroom 2), 15'-3" (rear-right garage), 22'-7", 20'-7", 19'-7", 24'-9" (upstairs), 10'-1" (front garage sides).
  • Overhead doors 18'×8' + 9'×8' (right side of front garage), 9'×8' (front of rear-right garage) – door schedule.

Estimates

  • EST Footprint traced from scanned sheet, ±0.5–1 ft.
  • EST Ridge heights are computed from plate + pitch × run. Small steps (≤0.5 ft) can show where computed planes meet at valleys. Mid-wall "plate varies" labels on the roof plan were not individually checked.
  • EST Upstairs front roof: the left 4:12 slope is set from the 20'-7" plate (reaches 24'-9" at the bedroom 4 / bath 4 wall). The right 4:12 slope is set from the 19'-7" plate, which leaves a short clerestory step.
  • EST Exterior walls are drawn as thin surfaces that rise to the roof plane above them, so the gable-end triangles are inferred.
  • EST Interior walls traced by hand from sheets 1–2. Positions are ±1 ft, some short closet walls are omitted, and door openings are only roughly gapped. Height: 10'-1" main, 9'-1" upstairs.
  • EST Door positions along walls approximate; widths from the door schedule.
  • EST Ground flat at finished floor.

Windows

  • As-built windows differ from the elevation sheets, so none are drawn yet. The layer is ready to fill from Steven's exterior photos (data: wall ID, offset from wall start, width, sill, head). Turn on "Wall IDs + lengths" to see wall IDs.

Not modeled

  • Lot lines, driveway, compass (site plan: 102'-0" front setback, 49'-8" to right lot line, not drawn). Vaulted ceilings. Cameras (none placed yet).
